Interface CreatedSlotResolver

All Known Implementing Classes:
CreatedSlotAdapter
public interface CreatedSlotResolver
Port (MK defines, MKC implements): resolve a CREATED_SLOT Address to its live in-menu slot and frame-relative position.

Why a port (the §0042 reason)

A created slot is an MKCSlot — an MKC type MK must never reference — and its on-screen position lives on that type (renderX/renderY, §0047), which is parked off the vanilla Slot.x/y. So MK cannot resolve a created slot or read its position directly. MKC registers an implementation (replacing the per-frame O(n) identity scan in SlotElement.resolve() with a session-cached binding); when MKC is absent the resolver is null and created-slot resolution simply yields empty (created slots need MKC) — vanilla, panel, and element resolution stay fully MK-alone.
